in_sanskrit.name: Irappa
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Lord Shiva's servant
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Irappa एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Irappa is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘Iru’ meaning ‘two’ and ‘appa’ meaning ‘father’. This name is a reference to Lord Shiva, who is often depicted as the father of the universe and the destroyer of evils. Irappa is believed to be a devotee or servant of Lord Shiva, making it a powerful and spiritual name for a baby boy in Hindu tradition.
